node.title: Re: Output to a >CSV file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: It looks like you're already outputting TSV format, aren't you? Anyway, for CSV (and TSV), I'd strongly recommend [mod://Text::CSV] (also install [mod://Text::CSV_XS] for speed). You can see one example of how to read and write CSV with it [id://1208318|here] (and here are [href://?node_id=3989;BIT=Text%3A%3ACSV%20-%3Eprint;a=haukex|a few more examples via Super Search]).
